identity.title: [v0.91.8][runtime-v3][launch] Simplify and harden local Runtime v3 launch path

values.goal: Make Runtime v3 start reliably through one Guardian-owned Rust launch path with coherent config, Observatory, and readiness behavior.
values.required_outcome: A clean checkout starts a real Runtime v3 kernel under Guardian, exposes coherent health and Observatory routes, performs an authenticated WebSocket exchange, and fails closed before readiness when required production adapters are unavailable.
authority_boundary: Guardian is process 0 and owns child lifecycle
Tokio/Axum/Rustls are the only local serving path
runtime readiness is not claimed until required adapters are real
operator_constraints: Rust/Tokio/Axum/Rustls only; no Python, shell lifecycle, sidecars, or fixture credit
No plaintext secrets or private-key material in tracked artifacts
Keep root main clean and work only in the bound worktree
Do not widen into distributed mesh or AWS
